preprocessing: Remove complete <<...>> spans including their contents; collapse whitespace; preserve other text. Reject text with no word tokens. Apply identically to every label and split. Preserve source records.
threshold_policy: Maximize phishing F1 on validation only over 0.05, 0.06, ..., 0.95. Break ties by fewer false positives, then closest to 0.50, then higher threshold. No hyperparameter search or train+validation refit.
diagnostics: Train/validation only: marker presence by label and marker-presence-only rule; verify no marker content survives preprocessing. No raw-text classifier is selected or compared on the final test set.
final_evaluation: Load the saved model and its validation-selected threshold. Evaluate all frozen test rows once for model selection purposes; deterministic reruns are verification only. Report confusion counts, accuracy, precision, recall, F1, legitimate false-positive rate and batch inference timing. Compare with the training-majority constant classifier. No test-driven tuning.
